FAQ

Good to know.

How do I pre-order?

Tap Pre-order now, fill in your delivery details and confirm. You receive an order ID once your order is saved. Dispatch of the next batch begins December 15, 2026.

How do I pay?

Scan the QR with any UPI app or use the UPI ID. Payments are manual; share your screenshot on WhatsApp so we can confirm. Your order stays "Payment Pending" until we confirm it.

What are the notebook specifications?

A 5.5" × 8.5" (approx.) workbook diary with 120 pages of 120 GSM dark blue paper, a leather and Kappa board cover with an elastic tape at the back, and hard case binding. See the Specifications section for the full list.
